# SQLite public-domain status

The SQLite authors have dedicated SQLite's deliverable code and documentation
to the public domain. The official statement is maintained at:

`https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html`

The statement permits copying, modification, publication, use, compilation,
sale, and distribution for commercial or non-commercial purposes. The
amalgamation archive does not contain a separate license file; this record
preserves the upstream status and source link without imposing an additional
license on SQLite.

The upstream source files also contain SQLite's public-domain blessing. This
repository does not alter or replace those notices.
